g.text: MemForge write, index, resolve and audit
reconstruct the file after the edit
[frontmatter does not parse as a mapping]
refuse generator markers, open comment, code fence;
copy the preamble as literal text in a code fence;
drop a preamble with a generator marker (SC-16)
named on stderr, left out, exit 1
open .memforge/snoozes one name at a time (SC-14)
[.memforge, snoozes or the snooze is a link]
a folder it cannot list is a violation
find git in absolute PATH entries (SC-06);
run it without the repository-local git variables (SC-05)
[not found, inside the store or its repository,
or its top level does not hold the store]
file names literal (SC-40), changed paths (a merge: against its first parent),
config and snooze paths (case variants, committed links,
link chains followed as the file system does;
snooze folder link and config link BLOCKERs),
waiver, alias, deletion rules (live member into archive/ counts)
on a merge, leave a finding to the merged branch
only when the merge keeps the branch's result and
every branch commit behind it is inside the window
waive listed commits, never one that
changes the waiver file; report "N waived"
violations, health; --strict exits 1 on any violation
audit runs only when someone runs it
no usable git: Tier 2 skipped, a WARN only
